messages:
Maya CS: Flagging escalation from Acme — they say after last night's deploy their multi-turn assistant started ignoring system instructions and important context in long sessions. Pasting their repro below.

Maya CS: 
```
Customer excerpt: 
System prompt: "You are Onboarding Helper. Always ask clarifying questions before answering. If user asks for code, include explanations."
Conversation length: ~2k tokens
Request body: {
  "model": "redwood-alpha-2.1",
  "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are Onboarding Helper..."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Step me through creating a workspace with restricted perms."}, ... many turns ... ]
  "max_tokens": 1024
}
Observed behavior: model returns a generic answer and never asks clarifying questions; later responses omit the system instructions entirely.
Request id: req_0x9f7a
Time: 2026-11-02T22:32:11Z
```

Jordan SRE: Thanks — can you confirm hosted vs private, and whether this was canary or prod rollout? Any example response text?

Maya CS: Hosted prod. Canary->prod finished at ~2026-11-02T22:10Z (deploy id deploy-2026-11-02-3a7f). Customer pasted one failing assistant reply: "Sure, here's how to create a workspace..." (no clarifying Qs, ignores system instruction). Full session attached above.

Evan Eng: Hypothesis: recent kernel-selection change and continuous-batching optimization might be pruning prefixes incorrectly for long sessions. Could be KV-cache eviction ordering bug. Any runtime logs with kv_cache_* warnings?

Jordan SRE: I repro'ed locally using their exact payload and got the same drop when conversation > ~1800 tokens. Minimal log snippet: 
```
[2026-11-02T22:33:05Z] INFO kernel_selector: selected kernel=attn-long-optim
[2026-11-02T22:33:05Z] WARNING kv_cache_prune: evicted_prefix_tokens=124
[2026-11-02T22:33:05Z] WARN prompt_builder: system_prompt_truncated_by_n_tokens=124
[2026-11-02T22:33:05Z] INFO generation: request_id=req_0x9f7a model=redwood-alpha-2.1 result=truncated_system_prompt
```

Priya ML: Also check tokenization changes between 2.0 -> 2.1. If token counts changed or we adjusted special-token handling, prompt assembly could be off. Also confirm quantization/codepath: q4_0 vs fp16 — padding/kv indexing differences have bitten us before.

Evan Eng: Quick A/B: redwood-alpha-2.0 (pre-deploy) returns expected behavior for same session. 2.1 fails. That points to runtime change, not model weights. Continuous-batching was flipped on by default in this canary.

Jordan SRE: @Evan Eng please open an urgent issue with repro steps and include the log snippet + request_id. I'll prepare a rollback plan.

Evan Eng: Opened ENG-12489 with repro script and logs. Repro curl: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '@acme_long_session.json' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat | jq .
```
Payload attached in ticket.

Maya CS: I've told the customer we have a repro and are investigating; asked them to hold traffic and to share any additional request_ids if they see more. They asked for ETA.

Priya ML: I'll diff the kernel-selection + kv_cache pruning codepaths and check for an off-by-one when continuous batching merges prefixes. Suspect a race where prefix length is computed before batch concat.

Jordan SRE: Action items: Evan — rollback canary -> stable for prod traffic. Priya — own root cause and test fix. Maya — keep customer updated. Target: hotfix/rollback decision in 4 hours. :clock4: 

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by Jordan SRE: deploy-2026-11-02-3a7f -> deploy-2026-11-01-stable (initiated).

Maya CS: Customer confirmed reduced incidents after rollback — monitoring for reappearances. Will update thread when they confirm fully resolved.
